comment_regular: Cross-fades from an active source sequence to an inactive destination: deactivates the source with the requested ease time, then activates the destination with the same transition time and caller-supplied priority/start/weight/time-sync values. Returns false unless source is active and destination inactive.
comment_repeatable: Cross-fades from an active source sequence to an inactive destination: deactivates the source with the requested ease time, then activates the destination with the same transition time and caller-supplied priority/start/weight/time-sync values. Returns false unless source is active and destination inactive.
confidence_scope: Bulk synchronization preserves source annotations; it does not independently verify their semantic claims. Established focused conclusions are documented in Findings/OctoberPass/README.md.
